name: Least privilege
short_description: Least privilege is the security principle of giving an identity the smallest role at the smallest scope for the shortest time that still lets it do its work, limiting what an attacker can reach if the account is compromised.

evidence.quote: Least. Privilege is the name for that habit, and it means giving someone the smallest role at the smallest scope
Give the agent the smallest amount of access it needs to do its job
O antídoto reside na implementação do acesso com privilégio mínimo para seus agentes,
This is the practical meaning of least privilege access.
Agent permissions must follow a least privileged design.
You can enforce lease privilege so each agent gets only the permissions it requires.
